versions.content: When entering the Repeat Message State from Bus Sleep Mode or Prepare Bus Sleep Mode because of CanNm_NetworkRequest() (active wakeup) and if CanNmImmediateNmTransmissions is greater zero, the NM PDUs shall be transmitted using CanNmImmediateNmCycleTime as cycle time. The transmission of the first NM PDU shall be triggered as soon as possible. After the transmission the Message Cycle Timer shall be reloaded with CanNmImmediateNmCycleTime. The CanNmMsgCycleOffset shall not be applied in this case.

When entering the Repeat Message State from Bus Sleep Mode or Prepare Bus Sleep Mode because of CanNm_NetworkRequest() (active wakeup) and if CanNmImmediateNmTransmissions is greater zero, the NM PDUs shall be transmitted using CanNmImmediateNmCycleTime as cycle time. The transmission of the first NM PDU shall be triggered as soon as possible. After the transmission the Message Cycle Timer shall be reloaded with CanNmImmediateNmCycleTime. The CanNmMsgCycleOffset shall not be applied in this case.
